description: Source code for a class 'AmazonAgentCoreConfig' implementing configuration and request/response handling for Bedrock AgentCore in a larger LLM framework.

classes.name: AmazonAgentCoreConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for Bedrock AgentCore, handling URL construction, request signing, response parsing, and streaming support.

methods.name: get_supported_openai_params
methods.description: Returns an empty list, indicating no OpenAI-compatible params supported.

methods.name: map_openai_params
methods.description: Maps OpenAI parameters to AgentCore parameters, here simply returning optional_params.

methods.name: get_complete_url
methods.description: Constructs the full request URL for AgentCore, including ARN extraction and region parsing.

methods.name: sign_request
methods.description: Signs the request with either a bearer token or AWS SigV4, depending on optional_params.

methods.name: _get_agent_runtime_arn
methods.description: Extracts the ARN from the model string.

methods.name: _extract_region_from_arn
methods.description: Extracts AWS region from the ARN string.

methods.name: _get_runtime_session_id
methods.description: Generates or retrieves a runtime session ID.

methods.name: _get_runtime_user_id
methods.description: Retrieves runtime user ID if provided.

methods.name: transform_request
methods.description: Transforms messages into AgentCore request payload, adding headers for session and user IDs.

methods.name: _extract_sse_json
methods.description: Parses JSON data from SSE lines.

methods.name: _extract_usage_from_event
methods.description: Extracts usage info from event metadata.

methods.name: _extract_content_delta
methods.description: Extracts text delta from contentBlockDelta event.

methods.name: _extract_content_from_message
methods.description: Extracts concatenated text content from message blocks.

methods.name: _calculate_usage
methods.description: Calculates token usage using a token counter utility.

methods.name: _parse_json_response
methods.description: Parses JSON response into AgentCoreParsedResponse.

methods.name: _get_parsed_response
methods.description: Determines response parsing method based on content type.

methods.name: _parse_sse_stream
methods.description: Parses SSE stream text into structured response.

methods.name: get_streaming_response
methods.description: Returns an iterator for SSE streaming responses.

methods.name: get_sync_custom_stream_wrapper
methods.description: Creates a custom stream wrapper for synchronous streaming requests.

methods.name: get_async_custom_stream_wrapper
methods.description: Creates a custom stream wrapper for asynchronous streaming requests.

methods.name: has_custom_stream_wrapper
methods.description: Property indicating support for custom streaming.

methods.name: supports_stream_param_in_request_body
methods.description: Indicates that 'stream' parameter should not be in request body.

methods.name: transform_response
methods.description: Transforms raw response into ModelResponse, parsing JSON or SSE, and handling usage data.

methods.name: validate_environment
methods.description: Validates or adjusts headers/environment before request.

methods.name: get_error_class
methods.description: Returns appropriate exception class for errors.

methods.name: should_fake_stream
methods.description: Indicates whether to fake streaming responses.
